name: 38879-longprefill-e4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine on one card. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, the ~4B-effective-parameter Gemma 4 configuration, ~16.0 GB of bf16 weights in one safetensors shard. Multimodal-capable, but served text-only here.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 256 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request exactly 8192 prompt tokens and exactly 150 output tokens, sent as a plain completion (`request_format: plain`, no chat template) with `ignore_eos: true`. Prompts are independently random and prefix caching is off. The engine tokenizes with `add_special_tokens=True` and Gemma prepends a BOS, so the reported prompt length is 8193; that is expected, not drift.
purpose: A long-document analysis service for 32 concurrent users, each sending 8k-token passages for short summaries on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Source checkout e69a265135ef48312d78130f64b7bfce4cd81a37
# (`git describe --tags` -> v0.19.1rc0-48-ge69a265135ef).

model: google/gemma-4-E4B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 32768
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128
enable-prefix-caching: false
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN
trust-remote-code: true
disable-log-stats: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
